'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**An explosion hits the [[Israel]]i-owned [[cargo ship]] ''MV Helios Ray'' in the [[Gulf of Oman]]. No injuries are reported among the ship's 28 crew members. Israeli media reports, citing unnamed Israeli government officials, that [[Iran]] was likely behind the blast. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-26/explosion-strikes-ship-in-gulf-of-oman-crew-safe (Bloomberg)]
*[[Zamfara kidnapping]]
**At least 317 girls are [[kidnap]]ped by armed bandits raiding a secondary school hostel in the [[Nigeria]]n state of [[Zamfara]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/26/nigerian-school-students-abducted-in-second-kidnapping-in-a-week (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2019–2021 Iraqi protests]]
**Security forces open fire against a crowd of demonstrators during anti-[[government of Iraq|government]] protests in [[Nasiriyah]], [[Iraq]], killing 3 people and wounding 47 others. Two other protestors have also been killed in the past few days. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/26/at-least-three-protesters-killed-in-southern-iraq-rights-monitor (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War in Donbas (2014–2022)|War in Donbass]] 
**[[Ukraine]] reports 10 [[Minsk Protocol|ceasefire]] violations in the [[Luhansk Oblast|Luhansk]] region. [https://www.unian.info/war/donbas-war-update-ukraine-records-10-ceasefire-violations-on-feb-25-11334971.html (Unian)]
*[[Batwa–Luba clashes]]
**An NGO vice-president met with 70 members of the [[Twa]] and [[Bantu peoples|Bantu]] in [[Nyunzu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], to ensure lasting peace in the [[Nyunzu Territory]]. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2021/02/26/actualite/societe/tanganyika-une-ong-invite-les-jeunes-de-nyunzu-sengager-pour-la-paix (Radio Okapi)]
*[[Ituri conflict]]
**Claude Ibalanky, the coordinator of the National Monitoring Mechanism of the Addis Ababa Agreement (MNS), reveals at a workshop organized by the MNS and [[MONUSCO]] in [[Kinshasa]] that there are residents taking advantage of the instability in eastern Congo. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2021/02/26/actualite/securite/rdc-la-demobilisation-des-miliciens-de-la-frpi-parmi-les-acquis (Radio Okapi)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]] 
**The [[Allied Democratic Forces]] (ADF) kill three civilians in an ambush on the Beni-Kasindi road. Congolese and [[MONUSCO]] troops positioned nearby then clashed with the ADF, forcing them to retreat. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2021/02/26/actualite/securite/beni-3-civils-tues-dans-une-embuscade-des-adf-sur-laxe-routier-beni (Radio Okapi)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[American Rescue Plan Act of 2021]]
***The [[United States House of Representatives]] votes  219-212 to pass [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]]'s [[United States dollar|$]]1.9 trillion [[American Rescue Plan|relief package]], which would provide $1,400 in direct payments. The bill will head to the [[United States Senate|Senate]] for a vote. [https://www.cnet.com/personal-finance/house-passes-bidens-1-9-trillion-stimulus-package/ (CNET)]
*Aftermath of the [[GameStop short squeeze]]
**The [[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]] temporarily halts the trading of 15 stocks, most of which are [[penny stock]]s, out of concern that online users were coordinating to artificially raise their value. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-26/sec-is-scouring-social-media-too-in-a-hunt-for-stocks-to-suspend (Bloomberg)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A small plane crashes in [[Gainesville, Georgia]], U.S., killing three people. [https://www.yahoo.com/gma/3-people-dead-plane-crashes-084828964.html (''Yahoo! News'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
*****The [[India]]n [[Government of India|government]] announces that people can choose their [[COVID-19]] [[vaccination]] centres when the vaccination campaign expands next week. This will allow people to choose whether they want to receive the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine or the [[BBV152|Bharat Biotech]] vaccine. [https://zeenews.india.com/india/people-can-choose-their-covid-19-vaccination-centre-says-govt-for-faster-roll-out-2344603.html (Zee News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Hong Kong]] begins administering [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]s to the general public with the [[Sinovac]] [[CoronaVac]] vaccine. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-hong-kong-kicks-off-vaccinations-sinovac-free-china-14286302 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]]n [[Ministry of Health (Indonesia)|Health Minister]] [[Budi Gunadi Sadikin]] issues a new regulation that authorizes a mutual assistance vaccine programme so that private companies can buy state-approved vaccines in order to vaccinate their staff. [https://nasional.tempo.co/read/1436709/menkes-budi-gunadi-resmi-keluarkan-aturan-soal-vaksinasi-mandiri (Tempo.co)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] begins a mass vaccination campaign against COVID-19 using the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[vaccine]], with the first doses administered to residents at about 200 [[nursing home]]s across the country. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Spotlight/Coronavirus/South-Korea-kicks-off-COVID-19-vaccination-campaign (Nikkei Asia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] approves the emergency use of the [[United States|American]] [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|Moderna]] and [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] vaccines. [https://www.dpa-international.com/topic/vietnam-approves-moderna-sputnik-v-vaccines-emergency-use-urn%3Anewsml%3Adpa.com%3A20090101%3A210226-99-602885 (dpa International)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nebraska]], [[Lineage B.1.1.7]]
*****[[Nebraska]] reports their first case of the Lineage B.1.1.7 variant in a person from [[Douglas County, Nebraska|Douglas County]]. [https://journalstar.com/lifestyles/health-med-fit/nebraska-identifies-first-case-of-uk-coronavirus-variant/article_9f9e4b04-b4e2-5b30-9797-1beb2be4a5fb.html (''Lincoln Journal Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[Health Canada]] authorizes the use of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine and a related vaccine made by the [[Serum Institute of India]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/health-canada-approves-two-astrazeneca-covid-19-vaccines-1.5325451 (CTV News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
****[[Belgium]] announces that easing of major COVID-19-related restrictions will be put on hold for another week due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 infections and the spread of the [[Lineage B.1.1.7]] variant. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/belgium-prolong-restrictions-virus-cases-rise-76132922 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Chamber of Deputies (Czech Republic)|Chamber of Deputies]] passes a new [[pandemic]] law that allows the [[Ministry of Health (Czech Republic)|health ministry]] and local authorities to shut down trade, production facilities, and events. In turn, the [[Government of the Czech Republic|government]] announces the new [[state of emergency]] from February 27 until March 28. [https://www.politico.eu/article/czech-republic-coronavirus-new-state-of-emergency/amp/ (''Politico.eu'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Finland]]
****Authorities in [[Greater Helsinki]] order the closure of public and private facilities, such as gyms, indoor sports venues, saunas, playgrounds, and swimming pools for two weeks beginning March 1 as part of measures to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/helsinki_authorities_tighten_coronavirus_restrictions_but_ministry_says_not_enough/11812963 (Yle)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[President of Hungary|President]] [[Janos Ader]] receives his first dose of [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] vaccine. [https://www.budapesttimes.hu/hungary/president-ader-receives-first-shot/ (''Budapest Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Slovenia]] reports their first case of the 501.V2 variant first detected in [[South Africa]] in a person from [[Maribor]] who recently travelled to [[Africa]]. [https://english.sta.si/2872585/south-african-variant-of-novel-coronavirus-confirmed-in-slovenia (STA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****The [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|health ministry]] announces that people under 55 who have already been infected with COVID-19 will be given just a single dose of the vaccine, six months after their infection. [https://www.thelocal.es/20210226/spains-under-55s-whove-had-covid-19-to-receive-just-one-vaccine-dose (''The Local Spain'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina|Argentinian]] [[Ministry of Health (Argentina)|Health Minister]] [[Carla Vizzotti]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.eldia.com/nota/2021-2-26-17-50-0-la-ministra-de-salud-carla-vizzoti-dio-positivo-de-coronavirus-politica-y-economia (''El Día'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
****[[Brasília]] enters a 24-hour [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdown|lockdown]] for all non-essential services due to an increase in COVID-19 cases that has pushed the city's [[intensive care unit]]s to near full capacity with more than 80% of beds already occupied. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-brazil-lockdown/brazils-capital-goes-into-lockdown-to-quell-covid-19-surge-idUSL1N2KW3KZ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ivory Coast]]
***[[Ivory Coast]] becomes the second country to receive vaccines via the [[COVAX]] initiative, with 500,000 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine manufactured by the [[Serum Institute of India]] arriving in the country. [https://www.africanews.com/amp/2021/02/26/ivory-coast-becomes-second-country-to-receive-covax-vaccines/ (Africanews)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Papua New Guinea]]
***[[Papua New Guinea]] reports a record 89 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,228. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210226-papua-new-guinea-sees-jump-in-coronavirus-cases (France 24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]]
**[[Myanmar]]'s [[List of diplomatic missions of Myanmar|Ambassador to the United Nations]] [[Kyaw Moe Tun]] addresses the [[United Nations|UN]] in [[New York City|New York]], calling for the international community to take the "strongest possible action" to remove the [[State Administration Council|military junta]] from power. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20210226-myanmar-s-un-ambassador-defies-junta-calls-for-global-action-to-overturn-coup (France 24)]
*[[Assassination of Jamal Khashoggi]], [[Saudi Arabia–United States relations]]
**The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] releases a previously classified intelligence report on the assassination of [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]] dissident journalist [[Jamal Khashoggi]], confirming that [[Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia|Saudi Crown Prince]] [[Mohammad bin Salman]] had approved of the assassination. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/02/26/us/politics/jamal-khashoggi-killing-cia-report.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack|aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
**[[Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Criminal charges brought in the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]], [[Death of Brian Sicknick]]
***The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] has reportedly identified a suspect in connection to the death of [[United States Capitol Police|Capitol Police]] officer Brian Sicknick during the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|storming]] of the [[United States Capitol|U.S. Capitol]] last month. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/02/26/politics/fbi-identify-suspect-sicknick/index.html (CNN)]
*''[[Begum v Home Secretary]]''
**The [[Supreme Court of the United Kingdom|UK Supreme Court]] rules that [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] supporter [[Shamima Begum]] is forbidden from returning to the [[United Kingdom]] to appeal the revocation of her [[British nationality law|citizenship]]. This overturns the decision by the [[Court of Appeal (England and Wales)|Court of Appeal]], citing four errors in their ruling. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/02/26/europe/shamima-begum-isis-ruling-uk-gbr-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2021 Croix-des-Bouquets jailbreak]]
**Arnel Joseph, a powerful [[crime in Haiti|Haitian gang leader]], is killed in a gun battle with [[Haitian National Police|police]] in [[L'Estère]] a day after escaping from prison during a riot. The death toll from the incident rise to a total of 25 people, including many civilians killed by the inmates after randomly opening fire in the streets. The prison's director, six inmates and police officers are among the dead. Sixty more prisoners who escaped are captured and arrested, while more than 200 others are still on the run. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-56219200 (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*The [[Belarus Olympic Committee]] elects [[Viktor Lukashenko]], son of [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]], as its new President. Lukashenko is currently suspended from the [[International Olympic Committee]] meaning Belarusian athletes will likely be forced to compete as an independent team in the upcoming [[2020 Summer Olympics|Tokyo Games]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/sports/belarusian-olympic-body-elects-lukashenko-s-son-as-leader-1.5325617 (CTV News)]
